project_type: Next.js 14 App Router + AWS Amplify Gen2 (TypeScript, fullstack)
build_system: Next.js 14 via npm scripts. Root tsconfig.json excludes 'amplify/' directory; amplify/ has its own tsconfig. Amplify backend uses ESM (amplify/package.json: {"type":"module"}). Path alias '@/*' maps to project root.
test_framework: None configured — verify with 'npm run build' (TypeScript compile + Next.js build check) and 'npm run lint'
test_command: npm run lint && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run lint' — must produce 0 errors. 2. Run 'npm run build' — must complete without TypeScript or Next.js errors. 3. For backend: run 'npx ampx sandbox' to deploy locally (requires AWS credentials). amplify_outputs.json is auto-generated by sandbox/deploy and is NOT in git — each dev must run the sandbox once before 'npm run dev'.
snapshot_or_generated_files: amplify_outputs.json — generated by 'npx ampx sandbox' or CI deploy. Never hand-edit. Not in git (currently missing from repo, which is normal for a fresh clone).
environment_constraints: amplify_outputs.json must exist before 'npm run dev' will succeed. The sandbox deploys real AWS resources; always run 'npx ampx sandbox --once' or 'npx ampx sandbox' before testing locally. Do not commit amplify_outputs.json.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md present. README says standard Next.js + Amplify Gen2 workflow. Commit to a feature branch, not main.
key_patterns: 1. CSS: the project uses plain CSS files (app/app.css, app/globals.css, app/page.module.css) — CSS Modules pattern is already in place via page.module.css. All new component styles use CSS Modules (.module.css files). 2. Amplify client: 'use client' components call generateClient<Schema>() from 'aws-amplify/data'. Amplify.configure(outputs) is called once in page.tsx — move to layout.tsx or a client provider. 3. Auth: @aws-amplify/ui-react ^6.5.5 is installed — the Authenticator component is available. 4. Storage: aws-amplify ^6.6.6 — use uploadData, getUrl from 'aws-amplify/storage'. 5. No extra UI libraries — only what is in package.json.
directory_structure: Root: Next.js App Router project. app/ = Next.js pages/layouts/styles. amplify/ = Amplify Gen2 backend definitions (own tsconfig + ESM). public/ = static assets. No src/ wrapper — all app code is in app/. New component files go in app/components/. New page routes go as app/[route]/page.tsx. CSS Modules go alongside their component.
